narrative.overview: A calibrated engineering instrument: atmospheric in its structural shell, crisp where timing and protocol reasoning happen.

rules.name: Signal Priority
rules.body: Accent colors must explain protocol meaning or state; decoration never competes with a waveform.

rules.name: Crisp Content
rules.body: Lesson prose and diagrams stay opaque and readable; never apply backdrop blur to every card.

dos: Use glass for structural navigation and overlays.
Preserve protocol meaning with labels and non-color cues.
donts: Do not return to a bare documentation shell.
Do not use neon cyberpunk signal palettes.
Do not use decorative SaaS metric cards.
Do not put frosted glass on every container.
Do not add motion that delays reading.
